thread:
jess: heads up — deploybot blocked the release for service-notifications. Reason: cosign timestamp verification failed (signature_too_future). image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/service-notifications:release-20260329

deploy-bot: Promote aborted: cosign signature timestamp outside allowed skew. sig_time=2026-03-29T17:02:10Z, local_time=2026-03-29T16:58:30Z, allowed_skew=2m. Audit ref: promote-1809999999

nikhil: that's weird — our cosign signer uses a KMS proxy that had clock drift during a short NTP hiccup. The signatures are valid but timestamp is ~3m in future relative to deploybot verifier.

jess: options: 1) retag and resign (new signature) 2) update verifier skew tolerance temporarily (risky) 3) manual digest pin and promote with override 4) hold release until we rotate/resign.

release-manager: minimal blast radius. prefer retag+resign if quick. Manual pin is ok for smoke but we need signed attestation for downstream Dedicated customers. How long to retag+resign?

nikhil: resign should take ~2-3 minutes once I re-run the signer. I'll retag to release-20260329+resign and push attestation. Need permission to run from ops host.

jess: please proceed. I'll open the short change window 11:00-11:10 PT and note in release notes.

nikhil: running resign sequence: fetch manifest, put-image with new tag, cosign sign -> output: "PutImage succeeded, tag=release-20260329+resign digest=sha256:dd44ee55..." Attestation attached.

registry-bot: Attestation replicate check: eu-west-1 replicate pending; attestation object visible in us-west-2. Estimated replication ~90s.

deploy-bot: Re-checking signatures: success. Promote started: release-20260329+resign -> canary 4% us-west-2. Audit: user=nikhil, reason="resign after signer clock drift".

jess: smoke results?

deploy-bot: Smoke: 4 canary pods healthy. Rolling to 10% scheduled in 15m if no alerts.

release-manager: release note: "service-notifications: retagged and resigned to address transient signer clock skew; no code changes. CI/infra ticket created to monitor signer NTP drift and add signer health check." Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1407

nikhil: PR to add signer clock health check queued. Also scheduled an emergency cron to NTP-sync the KMS proxy host.

jess: thanks all. closing unless canary alerts. :white_check_mark:
